definitions.gloss: come-from-behind loss; losing after being in the lead
definitions.explanation: A defeat in which a team or player was winning but ended up losing because the opponent came from behind. The opposite of a comeback victory.

examples.japanese: {逆転負|ぎゃくてんま}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{喫|きっ}した→喫する：29124_kissuru⟧。
{九回|きゅうかい}⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逆転負|ぎゃくてんま}け⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They lost after a comeback in the bottom of the ninth inning.

examples.japanese: {三点|さんてん}⟦リード→リード：11601_riido⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逆転負|ぎゃくてんま}け⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{悔|くや}しかった→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧だろう。
examples.english: Losing after leading by three points must have been frustrating for the players.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧ (reversal) + ⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧ (loss/defeat). Describes the frustrating situation of losing a game or match after having been in the lead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逆転負|ぎゃくてんま}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{喫|きっ}する→喫する：29124_kissuru⟧: to suffer a come-from-behind loss (formal/written)
- {逆転負|ぎゃくてんま}け⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to lose after leading
- {逆転負|ぎゃくてんま}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}らう: to suffer a reversal loss (colloquial)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {逆転負|ぎゃくてんま}け: losing after leading (disappointing for the team that was ahead)
- ⟦{逆転勝|ぎゃくてんが}ち→逆転勝ち：08584_gyakutengachi⟧: comeback victory (exciting for the team that was behind)

USAGE:
Very common in sports news and commentary, especially for baseball, soccer, and other team sports. Often appears in headlines. The verb ⟦{喫|きっ}する→喫する：29124_kissuru⟧ (to suffer/sustain) is the most natural formal pairing.
